MOVE_TOMES.//: Battle Re-work Part 14 (PT11 x6 -- note 06: 'move tomes (drops and shops)'): a tome teaches a battle pet one move of its type, from another type than its own, up to the pet's battle level; two tome moves a pet at most. A tome's move fights with its own type in the matchups. Warden Briar sells them (price, a coin sink); a boss you beat leaves one behind now and then (bossChance, on its own dice).
